name: Shiokaze no Kieru Umi ni
source:
One day, Susumu meets Kousuke on the beach. Kousuke tells Susumu about his plan to salvage a yacht. "I wanna go somewhere by yacht." Susumu agrees to his plan and starts to work with him. Mishio and Rikako join them later on, and co-work together. Susumu gradually feels attracted to Mishio. Will they be able to successfully repair the yacht...?

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
一天，进在海边遇见耕介。耕介向他讲述了打捞一艘游艇的计划：“我想乘游艇去某个地方。”进同意加入，并开始与他一同工作。后来，澪与理香子也加入进来，四人齐心协力。进逐渐被澪吸引。他们能够顺利修好游艇吗……？

[摘自Himeya Shop]
